description: Logical calls of data acquisition / datalogger mainframes (Keysight 34970A/34972A and DAQ970A/DAQ973A). Channels use the 3-digit form of the instrument, e.g. "101:120". Optional calls are generated from the library.

float_list.description: list of numbers (readings of the scan list, in scan order)

reset.description: Factory reset: abort scan, clear scan list, restore all measurement parameters to factory settings

clear_status.description: Clear event registers, error queue and alarm queue (does not clear enable registers)

query_event_status_register.description: Read and clear the Standard Event Status Register

enable_event_status_register.description: Enable bits in the Standard Event Status Register enable register

query_event_status_enable.description: Read the Standard Event Status Register enable register

enable_service_request_enable.description: Enable bits in the Service Request Enable register

query_service_request_enable.description: Read the Service Request Enable register

set_operation_complete.description: Set Operation Complete bit (bit 0) in the Standard Event Register at the end of the current scan

operation_complete_query.description: Operation complete query, returns 1 when the current operation completes

trigger_bus.description: Software (bus) trigger, used with TRIGger:SOURce BUS

wait_to_continue.description: Wait-to-continue: prevent further commands until all pending operations complete

set_power_on_status_clear.description: Power-on status clear: enable/disable clearing of enable registers at power-on

save_state.description: Save the present instrument state to the specified location

recall_state.description: Recall the instrument state stored at the specified location

abort.description: Abort a measurement in progress from a scan (readings remain in memory)

initiate_scan.description: Change the triggering system from idle to wait-for-trigger state; readings are stored in memory

fetch_readings.description: Transfer readings from memory to the output buffer (list of readings)

read_scan.description: Place the instrument in the wait-for-trigger state, scan the present scan list once and send readings to the output buffer (list of readings)

read_and_remove.description: Read and erase up to <max_count> readings from memory, starting with the oldest (list of readings)

input_impedance_auto.description: Enable/disable automatic input resistance (>10 GOhm on 100 mV, 1 V, 10 V ranges) for DC voltage measurements

preset.description: Instrument preset to a known configuration (aborts measurement, does not clear scan list)

card_power_on.description: Reset the module in the specified slot to its power-on state

query_card_type.description: Return the identity of the plug-in module in the specified slot

set_date.description: Set/query the instrument calendar (readings and alarms are stored with date)

query_scan_start_time.description: Return the time and date at the start of the most recent scan (yyyy,mm,dd,hh,mm,ss.sss)

set_interface.description: Select the remote interface (34970A only: GPIB or RS-232; only one interface enabled at a time)

query_line_frequency.description: Return the power-line reference frequency used for NPLC integration (50 or 60)

query_scpi_version.description: Return the version of the SCPI standard with which the instrument complies (1994.0)

query_alarm.description: Read one alarm event from the alarm queue (read and delete, FIFO, up to 20 alarms)

set_local.description: Place the instrument in local mode (front panel fully functional; not allowed over GPIB on the 34970A)

set_remote.description: Place the instrument in remote mode (most front panel keys disabled)

set_remote_lock.description: Local lockout mode (all front panel keys disabled)

instrument_dmm.description: Disable/enable the internal DMM (changing state issues a Factory Reset)

query_dmm_installed.description: Return 1 if the internal DMM is installed

select_channels.description: Select the channels to be included in the scan list (channels are 4-digit channel numbers in the (@ch_list) form, e.g. (@101:120); use ROUT:SCAN (@) to clear)

query_scan_size.description: Return the number of channels in the scan list

close_channel.description: Close the specified channels on a multiplexer or switch module

close_channel_exclusive.description: Open all channels on the module, then close the specified channels (one at a time)

open_channels.description: Open the specified channels on a multiplexer or switch module

set_channel_advance_source.description: Select the channel advance source for external scanning (internal DMM disabled), {EXTernal|BUS|IMMediate}

set_channel_delay.description: Add a delay (0 to 60 s, 1 ms resolution) between multiplexer channels in the scan list

set_channel_delay_auto.description: Enable/disable automatic channel delay on the specified channels

set_four_wire.description: Configure the specified channels for 4-wire external scanning without the internal DMM (34901A/34902A only)

query_relay_done.description: Return 1 when all relay operations on cards not involved in the scan are finished

monitor_channel.description: Select the channel to be displayed on the front panel (single channel, e.g. (@103))

query_monitor_data.description: Read one reading from the monitor channel (reading only, no units/time/channel/alarm)

set_monitor_state.description: Enable/disable the Monitor mode (continuous measurements on a single channel)

set_trigger_source.description: Select the trigger source for each sweep through the scan list

set_trigger_count.description: Specify the number of times to sweep through the scan list

set_trigger_timer.description: Set the trigger-to-trigger interval (0 to 359,999 s, 1 ms resolution) for the TIMer trigger source

configure_dc_voltage.description: Configure the specified channels for DC voltage measurements (does not initiate the scan)

configure_ac_voltage.description: Configure the specified channels for AC voltage measurements (resolution fixed at 6 1/2 digits)

configure_dc_current.description: Configure the specified channels (34901A/34902A ch 21/22 only) for DC current measurements

configure_ac_current.description: Configure the specified channels (34901A/34902A ch 21/22 only) for AC current measurements

configure_resistance.description: Configure the specified channels for 2-wire resistance measurements

configure_fresistance.description: Configure the specified channels for 4-wire resistance measurements (channels auto-paired with Bank 2)

configure_frequency.description: Configure the specified channels for frequency measurements

configure_period.description: Configure the specified channels for period measurements

configure_temperature.description: Configure the specified channels for temperature measurements

configure_totalize.description: Configure the specified totalizer channels on the multifunction module (34907A)

configure_digital_byte.description: Configure the instrument to scan the specified digital input channels (34907A) as byte data

query_configuration.description: Return the present function, range and resolution configuration on the specified channels

measure_dc_voltage.description: Configure and measure DC voltage (equivalent to CONFigure:VOLTage:DC followed by READ?)

measure_dc_current.description: Configure and measure DC current (34901A/34902A ch 21/22 only)

measure_ac_current.description: Configure and measure AC current (34901A/34902A ch 21/22 only)

measure_digital_byte.description: Configure and measure digital input byte data (34907A)

query_data_points.description: Return the total number of readings currently stored in reading memory

remove_readings.description: Read and erase the specified number of readings from memory, starting with the oldest

query_last_reading.description: Return the most recent reading(s) taken on the specified channel during the scan

set_memory_threshold.description: Set the number of readings that sets the Memory Threshold bit (bit 9) in the Standard Operation event register

display_text.description: Display a text message (up to 12 characters) on the front panel

clear_display_text.description: Clear the text message on the front-panel display

format_reading_alarm.description: Enable/disable the inclusion of alarm status information with retrieved readings

format_reading_channel.description: Enable/disable the inclusion of channel number information with retrieved readings

format_reading_time.description: Enable/disable the inclusion of a time stamp with retrieved readings

format_reading_time_type.description: Select the time format for time stamps: absolute (time of day with date) or relative (seconds since start of scan)

format_reading_unit.description: Enable/disable the inclusion of measurement units (VDC, OHM, etc.) with retrieved readings

set_alarm_mode.description: Select the configuration of the four TTL alarm output lines: latch or track mode

set_alarm_slope.description: Select the slope of the pulse from the four TTL alarm outputs

alarm_source.description: Assign one of four alarm numbers (1-4) to report any alarm conditions on the specified channels

clear_alarms.description: Clear all four alarm output lines

clear_alarm.description: Clear the specified alarm output line

set_temperature_unit.description: Select the temperature units (Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin) on the specified channels

set_voltage_range.description: Set the DC voltage measurement range (100 mV to 300 V)

set_voltage_range_auto.description: Enable/disable autoranging for DC voltage measurements

set_voltage_resolution.description: Set the DC voltage measurement resolution (setting resolution also sets integration time)

set_voltage_nplc.description: Set the integration time in number of power line cycles (PLCs) for DC voltage measurements

set_voltage_aperture.description: Enable the aperture mode and set the integration time in seconds for DC voltage measurements

set_ac_voltage_range.description: Set the AC voltage measurement range (100 mV to 300 V)

set_ac_voltage_range_auto.description: Enable/disable autoranging for AC voltage measurements

set_ac_bandwidth.description: Select the lowest expected input frequency (3, 20 or 200 Hz) to choose the AC filter for AC voltage measurements

set_dc_current_range.description: Set the DC current measurement range (10 mA to 1 A, ch 21/22 of 34901A/34902A)

set_dc_current_range_auto.description: Enable/disable autoranging for DC current measurements

set_dc_current_nplc.description: Set the integration time in power line cycles for DC current measurements

set_ac_current_range.description: Set the AC current measurement range

set_ac_current_range_auto.description: Enable/disable autoranging for AC current measurements

set_ac_current_bandwidth.description: Select the lowest expected input frequency (3, 20 or 200 Hz) to choose the AC filter for AC current measurements

set_resistance_nplc.description: Set the integration time in power line cycles for 2-wire resistance measurements

set_resistance_resolution.description: Set the 2-wire resistance measurement resolution in ohms

set_fresistance_nplc.description: Set the integration time in power line cycles for 4-wire resistance measurements

set_fresistance_resolution.description: Set the 4-wire resistance measurement resolution in ohms

set_frequency_range_lower.description: Set the lowest expected input frequency (3 to 300,000 Hz) for frequency measurements

set_frequency_aperture.description: Set the aperture time in seconds for frequency measurements

set_period_aperture.description: Set the aperture time in seconds (default 100 ms) for period measurements

set_temperature_nplc.description: Set the integration time in power line cycles for temperature measurements

set_temperature_aperture.description: Enable the aperture mode and set the integration time in seconds for temperature measurements

query_reference_junction.description: Return the internal reference junction temperature

set_temperature_transducer_type.description: Select the temperature transducer type: TCouple, RTD, FRTD or THERmistor

set_tc_type.description: Select the thermocouple type (B, E, J, K, N, R, S, T) for temperature measurements

set_rtd_type.description: Select the RTD type (85 or 91: 0.00385 or 0.00391 alpha) for temperature measurements

set_frtd_type.description: Select the FRTD type (85 or 91) for temperature measurements

set_thermistor_type.description: Select the thermistor type (2252, 5000 or 10000 ohms) for temperature measurements

set_tc_rjunction.description: Set the thermocouple reference junction temperature in Celsius

set_tc_rjunction_type.description: Select the thermocouple reference junction type (fixed or internal)

set_function.description: Select the measurement function on the specified channels (function name in quotes, e.g. FUNC "VOLT:DC")

query_digital_data.description: Configure the specified channels as inputs and read an 8-bit byte or 16-bit word digital pattern (34907A)

set_zero_auto.description: Enable/disable the autozero mode on the specified channels

set_totalize_type.description: Select the totalizer mode (read or read-and-reset) on the specified channels (34907A)

set_totalize_slope.description: Configure the specified totalizer channels to count on the rising or falling edge (34907A)

totalize_clear.description: Clear the totalizer count on the specified channels (34907A)

totalize_start.description: Start the totalizer counting on the specified channels (34907A)

totalize_stop.description: Stop the totalizer counting on the specified channels (34907A)

query_totalize_data.description: Read the totalizer count on the specified channels (34907A)

query_average.description: Return the average (arithmetic mean) of readings on the specified channels

query_average_min.description: Return the minimum reading on the specified channels

query_average_max.description: Return the maximum reading on the specified channels

query_average_count.description: Return the number of readings taken on the specified channels

query_average_ptpeak.description: Return the peak-to-peak value of readings on the specified channels

clear_average.description: Clear all statistical (average) data on the specified channels

set_lower_limit.description: Set the lower alarm limit on the specified channels

set_lower_limit_state.description: Enable/disable the lower alarm limit on the specified channels

set_upper_limit.description: Set the upper alarm limit on the specified channels

set_upper_limit_state.description: Enable/disable the upper alarm limit on the specified channels

set_scale_gain.description: Set the Mx+B scaling gain on the specified channels

set_scale_offset.description: Set the Mx+B scaling offset on the specified channels

null_offset.description: Set the Mx+B scaling offset to the present reading on the specified channels

set_scale_state.description: Enable/disable Mx+B scaling on the specified channels

set_scale_unit.description: Set the Mx+B scaling measurement label (up to 3 characters)

compare_data.description: Set the digital compare data pattern on the specified channels (34907A)

compare_mask.description: Set the digital compare mask on the specified channels (34907A)

compare_state.description: Enable/disable the digital compare mode on the specified channels (34907A)

compare_type.description: Select the digital compare mode: EQUal or NEQual (34907A)

query_alarm_condition.description: Read the condition register for the Alarm Register group (uses only bit 4)

enable_alarm_status.description: Enable bits in the enable register for the Alarm Register group

query_alarm_event.description: Read and clear the event register for the Alarm Register group

query_operation_condition.description: Read the condition register for the Standard Operation Register group

enable_operation_status.description: Enable bits in the enable register for the Standard Operation Register group

query_operation_event.description: Read and clear the event register for the Standard Operation Register group

query_questionable_condition.description: Read the condition register for the Questionable Data Register group

enable_questionable_status.description: Enable bits in the enable register for the Questionable Data Register group

query_questionable_event.description: Read and clear the event register for the Questionable Data Register group

status_preset.description: Preset all status registers to a known state

digital_output.description: Write an 8-bit byte or 16-bit word digital pattern to the specified digital I/O channels (34907A)

query_digital_output_state.description: Return the direction (input or output) of the specified digital I/O channels (34907A)

set_analog_output.description: Set the analog output voltage (0 to +12 V) on the specified channels (34907A)

error_query.description: read and clear one error from the error queue (up to 20 errors, FIFO)

operation_complete.description: set the OPC bit when all pending operations complete

set_trigger_delay.description: delay between the trigger and the first channel of the scan, in seconds

set_internal_dmm.description: enable/disable the internal DMM (the instrument issues a factory reset when the state changes)
